SoFresh Toothbrush's Patented Design
SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

What makes it more effective?
The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. When your typical soft toothbrush flattens out during brushing it actually makes your toothpaste more abrasive. When bristles flatten they create a flat surface with abrasive toothpaste that studies have shown can damage your teeth and gums. With our biodegradable bamboo toothbrush, you have not one but two reasons to smile bigger and brighter! Choosing an eco-friendly toothbrush means committing to protect our planet while safeguarding yourself and your family's oral hygiene.

 

About our bamboo brush handle:

Our bamboo toothbrush is made from 100% organic bamboo that is ergonomically designed for ease of use without straining your hands while brushing.

 

About our bristles:

Our soft bristles are made from charcoal-infused nylon. This makes them effective in removing plaque and tannins from teeth that cause staining and yet mild enough to protect the tooth's enamel.

What does it replace?

Our bamboo toothbrush replaces the old nasty plastic toothbrush that we have all been accustomed to. A plastic toothbrush takes about 400 years to decompose, whilst bamboo will only take around 4-6 months if you are using a home composter and about 3 years if you will put it back to the soil to decompose on its own.

 

Why is it better?

Bamboo is a renewable resource and in fact, the fastest-growing plant - which can be harvested in a span of about 5 years. This means that we do not have to worry about exhausting this resource, unlike other plants that takes more than a decade to mature before they can be harvested. To top it all off, bamboo is 100% biodegradable and guaranteed safe for our environment. Once you have used the bamboo toothbrush and are ready to discard it, all you have to do is to add it to your home composter and should only take around 4-6 months to decompose.

SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

What are the bristles made of?
SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

description:
Fingerbrushes vs. Traditional Handle Brushes

Many pets are put off when their owners try to stick a long, foreign object in their mouths to brush their teeth. Dogs and cats are often more embracing of their owners fingers, so fingerbrushes like ours are often the dental instrument of choices for vets and pet owners. 

Barkley's 360° Fingerbrush vs. Other Fingerbrushes

The most ergonomic finger toothbrush on the market, our 360° bristle design allows pet parents to brush and massage their pets' teeth with ease and comfort. Other fingerbrushes have bristles only on one side, making it hard to brush our pets' teeth, especially if they move around. Fully-surround bristles enable pet parents to brush quickly and successfully from any angle.

Safe for Pets

Silicone is in many ways a wonder material. Its softness and flexibility enable a comfortable fit for humans, while gentle for dogs and cats. It's also an inert, chemically stable substance that is indigestible, making it non-toxic. 

Hygienic 

Our silicone finger toothbrushes each come with a case to keep it covered, and can be boiled for complete sterilization (it can withstand a temperature of up to 400° F, and the boiling point of water is 212° F, so boil away). 

How to Use

Add a dime-sized amount of pet toothpaste (NEVER human toothpaste) to the fingerbrush. For pets that are new to brushing, allow them to first smell the toothpaste, then allow them to lick it. Slowly begin to brush their teeth in a circular motion. It may take a few days for pets to become accustomed to brushing. Don't give up - a little bit of progress each day is all you need!

description:
SunGrow Dog Toothbrush Set-2 Long & 2 Finger What toothpaste should I use for my dog?

Make sure to buy a toothpaste that is especially for dogs. Human toothpaste can be poisonous and harmful to pets. Let your dog lick a little of the dog toothpaste to get used to the flavor. If she doesn’t like the flavor, try another flavor out. Worst case scenario brushing your dog's teeth using water is better than nothing.

What if my dog is scared and resists brushing?

To keep your dog calm while you are brushing her teeth, talk to her throughout the exercise, use a soothing tone and tell her what a good pup she is. Start by brushing a few teeth at a time, then slowly add a couple more each day. Even 30 seconds of brushing teeth is better than not brushing at all. If your dog is reluctant to have their teeth brushed, try and at least start with the outsides of the canines and back teeth where the most plaque will build up.

What is the best way to use the toothbrush and finger piece?

Whether you are using the smaller or larger brush, always brush your pet’s teeth in circular motion. With small circles, you will be able to clean the top, bottom, and sides of your dog's teeth. Place the piece onto your index finger and use it to gently clean the precise areas. Don’t brush too hard or you will cause bleeding.

How often should I brush my dog or pets’ teeth?

Talk to your vet to find out exactly how many times a week your breed of dog needs to have their teeth brushed. That being said, the minimum number of times you should brush your dog’s teeth is once a week. Try and aim for at least twice a week, this will prevent periodontitis and other oral and dental problems.

SoFresh Toothbrush's Patented Design
SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

What makes it more effective?
The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

description:
Fingerbrushes vs. Traditional Handle Brushes

Many pets are put off when their owners try to stick a long, foreign object in their mouths to brush their teeth. Dogs and cats are often more embracing of their owners fingers, so fingerbrushes like ours are often the dental instrument of choices for vets and pet owners. 

Barkley's 360° Fingerbrush vs. Other Fingerbrushes

The most ergonomic finger toothbrush on the market, our 360° bristle design allows pet parents to brush and massage their pets' teeth with ease and comfort. Other fingerbrushes have bristles only on one side, making it hard to brush our pets' teeth, especially if they move around. Fully-surround bristles enable pet parents to brush quickly and successfully from any angle.

Safe for Pets

Silicone is in many ways a wonder material. Its softness and flexibility enable a comfortable fit for humans, while gentle for dogs and cats. It's also an inert, chemically stable substance that is indigestible, making it non-toxic. 

Hygienic 

Our silicone finger toothbrushes each come with a case to keep it covered, and can be boiled for complete sterilization (it can withstand a temperature of up to 400° F, and the boiling point of water is 212° F, so boil away). 

How to Use

Add a dime-sized amount of pet toothpaste (NEVER human toothpaste) to the fingerbrush. For pets that are new to brushing, allow them to first smell the toothpaste, then allow them to lick it. Slowly begin to brush their teeth in a circular motion. It may take a few days for pets to become accustomed to brushing. Don't give up - a little bit of progress each day is all you need!

💘💘Steps For Usage:
💘Start training by placing a little dog toothpaste on your finger and let your dog lick the paste from your hand. Do this step several days in a row, and follow it with a treat reward and lots of praise.
💘Place a little of the paste on your pet's large canine teeth in front. This gets your dog used to having something placed against his teeth and gums. Do this step for several days, and again, follow it with a reward and praise.
💘Now introduce the toothbrush you will use for regular brushing. Place some dog toothpaste on it and allow your pet to lick it from the brush. It will get your pet used to the texture - and of having the brush near his teeth and gums. Praise and reward your dog, and repeat this step for several days.
💘 In the final phase, you will actually brush your dog's teeth. Gently hold back your pet's lips and hold the brush at a 45 degree angle to the gumline. Brush the outside of each tooth, moving the brush gently back and forth. Talk to your dog in a soothing voice and always follow brushing sessions with a treat. Brush just a few teeth the first time, and gradually lengthen the session each time until you're brushing all the teeth.
💘 When finished, be sure to reward him with lots of petting and praise. The rewards and praise will help him associate brushing as a positive, rewarding experience.

모든 개는 그들을 돌보는 사람처럼 건강하고 좋은 그루밍 루틴이 필요합니다. 칫솔질도 예외는 아닙니다.

개 치아 위생은 건강한 애완 동물을 유지하는 데 중요합니다.

강아지의 치아에 도달하도록 완벽한 각도.

SunGrow Dog Toothbrush Set-2 Long & 2 Finger What toothpaste should I use for my dog?

Make sure to buy a toothpaste that is especially for dogs. Human toothpaste can be poisonous and harmful to pets. Let your dog lick a little of the dog toothpaste to get used to the flavor. If she doesn’t like the flavor, try another flavor out. Worst case scenario brushing your dog's teeth using water is better than nothing.

What if my dog is scared and resists brushing?

To keep your dog calm while you are brushing her teeth, talk to her throughout the exercise, use a soothing tone and tell her what a good pup she is. Start by brushing a few teeth at a time, then slowly add a couple more each day. Even 30 seconds of brushing teeth is better than not brushing at all. If your dog is reluctant to have their teeth brushed, try and at least start with the outsides of the canines and back teeth where the most plaque will build up.

What is the best way to use the toothbrush and finger piece?

Whether you are using the smaller or larger brush, always brush your pet’s teeth in circular motion. With small circles, you will be able to clean the top, bottom, and sides of your dog's teeth. Place the piece onto your index finger and use it to gently clean the precise areas. Don’t brush too hard or you will cause bleeding.

How often should I brush my dog or pets’ teeth?

Talk to your vet to find out exactly how many times a week your breed of dog needs to have their teeth brushed. That being said, the minimum number of times you should brush your dog’s teeth is once a week. Try and aim for at least twice a week, this will prevent periodontitis and other oral and dental problems.

description: Keep your pet's teeth sparkly clean with this toothbrush. Double angled head makes brushing easier and cleans more surface for greater plaque removal. Just like humans, pets benefit from good oral hygiene. Remember that brushing teeth is not a natural action for your pets. Please consider the following steps before introducing any toothbrush to your pet. The goal should be for your pet to believe they are receiving a treat while you are actually brushing their teeth. This is done through a series of small baby steps. Start off by applying a pet toothpaste onto your finger and feeding it to your pet as a treat for a couple of days. Give lots of positive affection and praise. Next, apply the toothpaste onto the toothbrush and start offering the paste as a treat. You should not try to brush your pet's teeth at this time. After a few days, you should be ready to start brushing one tooth one day a time. Once they are comfortable with the brushing action, you may brush all of their teeth in one sitting. Try focusing on the gum line. If at any point you meet any negative resistance from your pet, then go back to the previous step for a longer period. There is a large variety of toothpaste flavors if your pet is picky.

description:
You only get one set of teeth, so you should take the best possible care of them. The Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush and UV Sanitizing Base uses sonic technology and four brush modes to clean and whiten your smile, encourage healthy gums, and remove surface stains. Choose from: “Clean” for a thorough, deep clean; “Soft” for an extra-gentle brushing; “Whiten” for polishing away surface stains; and “Massage” to stimulate gums, which can help reduce tartar buildup that can lead to gum disease.

The Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush and UV Sanitizing Base brushes your teeth using 40,000 tiny strokes per minute, compared to just 300 strokes per minute (on average) you are able to do with a manual toothbrush. It also has an auto-shut off function after you’ve brushed for the American Dental Association-recommended two minutes, so you don’t even have to think about it. What’s more, a 30-second interval timer reminds you to move from one section of your mouth to the next so that all of your teeth get cleaned evenly and thoroughly.

One of the best parts of the Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush is that the countertop charging base also operates as a UV sanitizer for your brush heads. Hundreds of millions of bacteria and microorganisms live in our mouths and can cause tooth decay and gum disease, and these exact bacteria end up on our toothbrushes. However, just 8 minutes under the UV light of the Dazzlepro UV Sanitizing Base after each time you brush kills 99.9% of these bacteria, ensuring that your toothbrush is clean and ready and for the next time you use it. To keep your toothbrush protected from germs in between uses, keep your brush head in the sanitizer.

How to Use the Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush and UV Sanitizing Base
Connect your brush head to the Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush handle use the Mode button to cycle through the different modes until you find the one you’d like. Apply a small amount of toothpaste to the brush head, gently place the toothbrush bristles against your teeth at a slight angle towards your gum line, and press the On/Off button. Brush for the full two minutes, using light pressure and moving the brush head in small circular motions, letting the brush head do the work. When the Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush pauses, it’s time to move to the next quadrant. When the brush shuts off, rinse your brush of any remaining toothpaste, dry the brush handle before placing it on the base, and dry your brush head to place in the UV Sanitizer.

To sanitize your brush heads, open the UV Sanitizer and place the brush heads over the small pegs with the bristles facing the bulb. Once the door is complete, the sanitization process will begin, and the sanitizing chamber will emit a blue glow for 8 minutes. When the process is complete, the sanitizer will shut off automatically.

Caring for the Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush and UV Sanitizing Base
It’s recommended that the Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush and UV Sanitizing Base is fully charged prior to the first use. A full charge takes approximately 24 hours and yields about 10 days of regular brushing. To maintain full power, store the Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush on the charging base after each use.

Clean the toothbrush handle by wiping with a clean, soft cloth. Wipe off any excess water before placing on the charging base or in the sanitizing compartment. To clean the charging base, unplug the unit before wiping down with a clean, dry, soft cloth. Rinse brush heads thoroughly after each use and wipe off any excess water before placing in the UV Sanitizing Compartment. Replace brush heads every three months.

Never submerge the Dazzlepro Elements Sonic Toothbrush or UV Sanitizing Base in water, or place it under running water. Not dishwasher safe.

SoFresh Toothbrush's Patented Design
SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

What makes it more effective?
The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. When your typical soft toothbrush flattens out during brushing it actually makes your toothpaste more abrasive. When bristles flatten they create a flat surface with abrasive toothpaste that studies have shown can damage your teeth and gums. This is especially important if you use 'whitening' toothpaste, which is usually very abrasive.

How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

What are the bristles made of?
SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

SoFresh Toothbrush's Patented Design
SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

What are the bristles made of?
SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

description:
Why brushing the teeth
Home dental care is one of the best ways to help keep your dog's teeth and gums healthy. Start as early as possible in your canine friend's life so he or she will become accustomed to the brushing process.

How often should I brush my dog’s teeth
Your dog's teeth should be brushed as often as possible, ideally every day. There are numerous dental care products, pastes, solutions, brushes; chew toys and dental diets that help you provide your dog with the home dental care he deserves.

At-home teeth cleaning tips
- Use a specially designed dog toothbrush or a recommended alternative
- Never use human toothpaste. Instead, use pet-safe toothpaste with a flavor favorable to your dog’s taste buds
- Give your dog a small sample of the toothpaste to introduce the taste
- Lift the lip to expose the outside surfaces of your dog’s gums and teeth
- Brush with gentle motions to clean the teeth and gums, as you would your own
- Clean the outside (cheek-facing) surfaces, as most pets will not allow you to brush the inside surface of the teeth
- Be sure to reach the back upper molars and canines, as these teeth tend to quickly build up tartar
- Reward your dog with play, petting or a favorite activity to positively reinforce the brushing process

SoFresh Toothbrush's Patented Design

The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

What are the bristles made of?
SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

What makes it more effective?
The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. When bristles flatten they create a flat surface with abrasive toothpaste that studies have shown can damage your teeth and gums. This is especially important if you use 'whitening' toothpaste, which is usually very abrasive.

How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

description:
With our biodegradable bamboo toothbrush, you have not one but two reasons to smile bigger and brighter! Choosing an eco-friendly toothbrush means committing to protect our planet while safeguarding yourself and your family's oral hygiene.

 

About our bamboo brush handle:

Our bamboo toothbrush is made from 100% organic bamboo that is ergonomically designed for ease of use without straining your hands while brushing.

 

About our bristles:

Our soft bristles are made from charcoal-infused nylon. This makes them effective in removing plaque and tannins from teeth that cause staining and yet mild enough to protect the tooth's enamel.
While we understand that our bristles are not made from 100% organic and biodegradable material just yet, we have at least eliminated about 90% of the plastic used in making our bamboo toothbrush.

 

What does it replace?

Our bamboo toothbrush replaces the old nasty plastic toothbrush that we have all been accustomed to. A plastic toothbrush takes about 400 years to decompose, whilst bamboo will only take around 4-6 months if you are using a home composter and about 3 years if you will put it back to the soil to decompose on its own.

 

Why is it better?

Bamboo is a renewable resource and in fact, the fastest-growing plant - which can be harvested in a span of about 5 years. This means that we do not have to worry about exhausting this resource, unlike other plants that takes more than a decade to mature before they can be harvested. To top it all off, bamboo is 100% biodegradable and guaranteed safe for our environment. Once you have used the bamboo toothbrush and are ready to discard it, all you have to do is to add it to your home composter and should only take around 4-6 months to decompose.

Good oral hygiene involves cleaning our teeth daily, but we don’t always consider the effect synthetic and toxic ingredients found in conventional oral care, have on our health

Georganics was born as a result of Alex trying many high fluoride products in a bid to rid his unexplainable cavities, only to find they didn’t work. A change to his diet was the next option. A couple of months in, Alex decided it wasn’t just the food he was eating he needed to make a change to but also the products he was using; soaps, creams, deodorants…everything. He found natural alternatives for most things but struggled to find a pure toothpaste. Not one to give up, Alex made his own, left his job in the city and created Georganics.

Selling first at local farmer's market and seeing that some people were intrigued, some thought it was a crazy idea but others were relieved, they too had been searching for a pure and natural toothpaste for a long time. It was then that we realised that Georganics needed to reach more people./br>
Selling online was the next step. Customer feedback was positive, people were loving the eco toothpaste. These positive comments motivated us to experiment with the toothpaste ingredients and from this we developed the Toothpowder and Oil Pulling Mouthwash we know and love today. A few months later we took part in an accelerator course in Sussex. We fell in love with the rolling hills and green fields and decided it was where Georganics should be based. As demand grew and production picked up, Alex and Charles partnered up and as a result of we have now grown into one of Europe’s most trusted brands of genuinely natural oral health care.Instead of plastic, the biodegradable handle on this toothbrush is made from certified FSC Beechwood from Switzerland. None of the bristles contain BPA either. As with all toothbrushes, it is sensible to replace every three months and it should be stored upright to allow it to dry between brushes.

The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

description:
SoFresh Toothbrush's Patented Design
SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

What makes it more effective?
The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. When your typical soft toothbrush flattens out during brushing it actually makes your toothpaste more abrasive. When bristles flatten they create a flat surface with abrasive toothpaste that studies have shown can damage your teeth and gums. This is especially important if you use 'whitening' toothpaste, which is usually very abrasive.

How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

What are the bristles made of?
SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

description:
With our biodegradable bamboo toothbrush, you have not one but two reasons to smile bigger and brighter! Choosing an eco-friendly toothbrush means committing to protect our planet while safeguarding yourself and your family's oral hygiene.

 

About our bamboo brush handle:

Our bamboo toothbrush is made from 100% organic bamboo that is ergonomically designed for ease of use without straining your hands while brushing.

 

About our bristles:

Our soft bristles are made from charcoal-infused nylon. This makes them effective in removing plaque and tannins from teeth that cause staining and yet mild enough to protect the tooth's enamel.
While we understand that our bristles are not made from 100% organic and biodegradable material just yet, we have at least eliminated about 90% of the plastic used in making our bamboo toothbrush.

 

What does it replace?

Our bamboo toothbrush replaces the old nasty plastic toothbrush that we have all been accustomed to. A plastic toothbrush takes about 400 years to decompose, whilst bamboo will only take around 4-6 months if you are using a home composter and about 3 years if you will put it back to the soil to decompose on its own.

 

Why is it better?

Bamboo is a renewable resource and in fact, the fastest-growing plant - which can be harvested in a span of about 5 years. This means that we do not have to worry about exhausting this resource, unlike other plants that takes more than a decade to mature before they can be harvested. To top it all off, bamboo is 100% biodegradable and guaranteed safe for our environment. Once you have used the bamboo toothbrush and are ready to discard it, all you have to do is to add it to your home composter and should only take around 4-6 months to decompose.

description:
With our biodegradable bamboo toothbrush, you have not one but two reasons to smile bigger and brighter! Choosing an eco-friendly toothbrush means committing to protect our planet while safeguarding yourself and your family's oral hygiene.

 

About our bamboo brush handle:

Our bamboo toothbrush is made from 100% organic bamboo that is ergonomically designed for ease of use without straining your hands while brushing.

 

About our bristles:

Our soft bristles are made from charcoal-infused nylon. This makes them effective in removing plaque and tannins from teeth that cause staining and yet mild enough to protect the tooth's enamel.
While we understand that our bristles are not made from 100% organic and biodegradable material just yet, we have at least eliminated about 90% of the plastic used in making our bamboo toothbrush.

 

What does it replace?

Our bamboo toothbrush replaces the old nasty plastic toothbrush that we have all been accustomed to. A plastic toothbrush takes about 400 years to decompose, whilst bamboo will only take around 4-6 months if you are using a home composter and about 3 years if you will put it back to the soil to decompose on its own.

 

Why is it better?

Bamboo is a renewable resource and in fact, the fastest-growing plant - which can be harvested in a span of about 5 years. This means that we do not have to worry about exhausting this resource, unlike other plants that takes more than a decade to mature before they can be harvested. To top it all off, bamboo is 100% biodegradable and guaranteed safe for our environment. Once you have used the bamboo toothbrush and are ready to discard it, all you have to do is to add it to your home composter and should only take around 4-6 months to decompose.

Good oral hygiene involves cleaning our teeth daily, but we don’t always consider the effect synthetic and toxic ingredients found in conventional oral care, have on our health

Georganics was born as a result of Alex trying many high fluoride products in a bid to rid his unexplainable cavities, only to find they didn’t work. A change to his diet was the next option. A couple of months in, Alex decided it wasn’t just the food he was eating he needed to make a change to but also the products he was using; soaps, creams, deodorants…everything. He found natural alternatives for most things but struggled to find a pure toothpaste. Not one to give up, Alex made his own, left his job in the city and created Georganics.

Selling first at local farmer's market and seeing that some people were intrigued, some thought it was a crazy idea but others were relieved, they too had been searching for a pure and natural toothpaste for a long time. It was then that we realised that Georganics needed to reach more people./br>
Selling online was the next step. Customer feedback was positive, people were loving the eco toothpaste. These positive comments motivated us to experiment with the toothpaste ingredients and from this we developed the Toothpowder and Oil Pulling Mouthwash we know and love today. A few months later we took part in an accelerator course in Sussex. We fell in love with the rolling hills and green fields and decided it was where Georganics should be based. As demand grew and production picked up, Alex and Charles partnered up and as a result of we have now grown into one of Europe’s most trusted brands of genuinely natural oral health care.Instead of plastic, the biodegradable handle on this toothbrush is made from certified FSC Beechwood from Switzerland. None of the bristles contain BPA either. As with all toothbrushes, it is sensible to replace every three months and it should be stored upright to allow it to dry between brushes.

description:
With our biodegradable bamboo toothbrush, you have not one but two reasons to smile bigger and brighter! Choosing an eco-friendly toothbrush means committing to protect our planet while safeguarding yourself and your family's oral hygiene.

 

About our bamboo brush handle:

Our bamboo toothbrush is made from 100% organic bamboo that is ergonomically designed for ease of use without straining your hands while brushing.

 

About our bristles:

Our soft bristles are made from charcoal-infused nylon. This makes them effective in removing plaque and tannins from teeth that cause staining and yet mild enough to protect the tooth's enamel.
While we understand that our bristles are not made from 100% organic and biodegradable material just yet, we have at least eliminated about 90% of the plastic used in making our bamboo toothbrush.

 

What does it replace?

Our bamboo toothbrush replaces the old nasty plastic toothbrush that we have all been accustomed to. A plastic toothbrush takes about 400 years to decompose, whilst bamboo will only take around 4-6 months if you are using a home composter and about 3 years if you will put it back to the soil to decompose on its own.

 

Why is it better?

Bamboo is a renewable resource and in fact, the fastest-growing plant - which can be harvested in a span of about 5 years. This means that we do not have to worry about exhausting this resource, unlike other plants that takes more than a decade to mature before they can be harvested. To top it all off, bamboo is 100% biodegradable and guaranteed safe for our environment. Once you have used the bamboo toothbrush and are ready to discard it, all you have to do is to add it to your home composter and should only take around 4-6 months to decompose.

When bristles flatten they create a flat surface with abrasive toothpaste that studies have shown can damage your teeth and gums. This is especially important if you use 'whitening' toothpaste, which is usually very abrasive.

How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

What are the bristles made of?
SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

SoFresh Toothbrush's Patented Design
SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

What makes it more effective?
The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. When your typical soft toothbrush flattens out during brushing it actually makes your toothpaste more abrasive. When bristles flatten they create a flat surface with abrasive toothpaste that studies have shown can damage your teeth and gums. This is especially important if you use 'whitening' toothpaste, which is usually very abrasive.

How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

What are the bristles made of?
SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

IP Code
The IP Code (or International Protection Rating, sometimes also interpreted as Ingress Protection Rating*) consists of the letters IP followed by two digits and an optional letter. As defined in international standard IEC 60529, it classifies the degrees of protection provided against the intrusion of solid objects (including body parts like hands and fingers), dust, accidental contact, and water in electrical enclosures. The standard aims to provide users more detailed information than vague marketing terms such as waterproof.
The digits (characteristic numerals) indicate conformity with the conditions summarized in the tables below. For example, an electrical socket rated IP22 is protected against insertion of fingers and will not be damaged or become unsafe during a specified test in which it is exposed to vertically or nearly vertically dripping water. IP22 or 2X are typical minimum requirements for the design of electrical accessories for indoor use.

description:
WHY WE MADE THIS

You’ve got braces. We’ve got the toothbrush. Our BrushCare Ortho Soft Toothbrush is designed with V-Shaped bristles to allow you to brush and clean effectively over and around your braces and orthodontic appliances.

It’s got soft bristles that are so fine, they can brush away hidden plaque. The brush head isn’t just compact, it’s oval shaped to go further. The handle has a non-slip grip. And there’s even a cover – so you can take it with you wherever you go.

V-Shaped Bristles
Effectively clean around braces and other orthodontic appliances.
Soft, Slim Microfine Bristles with Polished End-Rounded Tips
Gently protect your tooth enamel while brushing out plaque in small spaces and gum pockets.
Compact Oval-Shaped Brush Head

Slim, Flat Handle with Non-slip Grip and Thumb Rest
Makes for comfortable handling while brushing, providing control and stability when things get wet.
Toothbrush Cover

HOW TO USE

Brush gently with short strokes. Pay more attention to areas around the gum line, teeth at the back, and areas around fillings, crowns or other dental restorations.

description:
What toothpaste should I use for my dog?

Make sure to buy a toothpaste that is especially for dogs. Human toothpaste can be poisonous and harmful to pets. Let your dog lick a little of the dog toothpaste to get used to the flavor. If she doesn’t like the flavor, try another flavor out. Worst case scenario brushing your dog's teeth using water is better than nothing.

What if my dog is scared and resists brushing?

To keep your dog calm while you are brushing her teeth, talk to her throughout the exercise, use a soothing tone and tell her what a good pup she is. Start by brushing a few teeth at a time, then slowly add a couple more each day. Even 30 seconds of brushing teeth are better than not brushing at all. If your dog is reluctant to have their teeth brushed, try and at least start with the outsides of the canines and back teeth where the most plaque will build up.

What is the best way to use the toothbrush and finger piece?

Whether you are using the smaller or larger brush, always brush your pet’s teeth in circular motion. With small circles, you will be able to clean the top, bottom, and sides of your dog's teeth. Place the piece onto your index finger and use it to gently clean the precise areas. Don’t brush too hard or you will cause bleeding.

How often should I brush my dog or pets’ teeth?

Talk to your vet to find out exactly how many times a week your breed of dog needs to have their teeth brushed. That being said, the minimum number of times you should brush your dog’s teeth is once a week. Try and aim for at least twice a week, this will prevent periodontitis and other oral and dental problems.

description:
What toothpaste should I use for my dog?

Make sure to buy a toothpaste that is especially for dogs. Human toothpaste can be poisonous and harmful to pets. Let your dog lick a little of the dog toothpaste to get used to the flavor. If she doesn’t like the flavor, try another flavor out. Worst case scenario brushing your dog's teeth using water is better than nothing.

What if my dog is scared and resists brushing?

To keep your dog calm while you are brushing her teeth, talk to her throughout the exercise, use a soothing tone and tell her what a good pup she is. Start by brushing a few teeth at a time, then slowly add a couple more each day. Even 30 seconds of brushing teeth are better than not brushing at all. If your dog is reluctant to have their teeth brushed, try and at least start with the outsides of the canines and back teeth where the most plaque will build up.

What is the best way to use the toothbrush and finger piece?

Whether you are using the smaller or larger brush, always brush your pet’s teeth in circular motion. With small circles, you will be able to clean the top, bottom, and sides of your dog's teeth. Place the piece onto your index finger and use it to gently clean the precise areas. Don’t brush too hard or you will cause bleeding.

How often should I brush my dog or pets’ teeth?

Talk to your vet to find out exactly how many times a week your breed of dog needs to have their teeth brushed. That being said, the minimum number of times you should brush your dog’s teeth is once a week. Try and aim for at least twice a week, this will prevent periodontitis and other oral and dental problems.

SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material called Poly Buthyl Teleputalate. This special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

description:
Fingerbrushes vs. Traditional Handle Brushes

Many pets are put off when their owners try to stick a long, foreign object in their mouths to brush their teeth. Dogs and cats are often more embracing of their owners fingers, so fingerbrushes like ours are often the dental instrument of choices for vets and pet owners. 

Barkley's 360° Fingerbrush vs. Other Fingerbrushes

The most ergonomic finger toothbrush on the market, our 360° bristle design allows pet parents to brush and massage their pets' teeth with ease and comfort. Other fingerbrushes have bristles only on one side, making it hard to brush our pets' teeth, especially if they move around. Fully-surround bristles enable pet parents to brush quickly and successfully from any angle.

Safe for Pets

Silicone is in many ways a wonder material. Its softness and flexibility enable a comfortable fit for humans, while gentle for dogs and cats. It's also an inert, chemically stable substance that is indigestible, making it non-toxic. 

Hygienic 

Our silicone finger toothbrushes each come with a case to keep it covered, and can be boiled for complete sterilization (it can withstand a temperature of up to 400° F, and the boiling point of water is 212° F, so boil away). 

How to Use

Add a dime-sized amount of pet toothpaste (NEVER human toothpaste) to the fingerbrush. For pets that are new to brushing, allow them to first smell the toothpaste, then allow them to lick it. Slowly begin to brush their teeth in a circular motion. It may take a few days for pets to become accustomed to brushing. Don't give up - a little bit of progress each day is all you need!

Ideal für den Einsatz als Zahnsteinentferner für Hunde, dieses Spray ist eine einfache, effektive und effiziente Möglichkeit, die Zähne Ihres Hundes in Spitzenform zu halten. تستخدم بيور آند مصقولة مكونات طبيعية لتقديم حلول آمنة وبسيطة للعناية بالحيوانات الأليفة ومستلزمات صحة الكلاب. إن تركيبة بخاخ الأسنان الطبيعي بيور آند مصقولة للتحكم في جير الأسنان هي الحل الأمثل للحفاظ على صحة فم كلبك. إذا كان تنظيف أسنان كلبك لا يعمل بشكل جيد ولكنك لا تزال تهتم بالعناية الصحيحة بفم الكلب، فلا تبحث أكثر من هذا البخاخ سهل الاستخدام لتنظيف فم الكلب. يعمل بخاخ أسنان الكلاب كمعطر لنفس الكلب ومزيل لجير الكلاب. سيوفر لك بخاخ الكلاب هذا رحلة إلى الطبيب البيطري لتنظيف أسنان الكلب. كما أنه مفيد للغاية إذا كنت تواجه صعوبة في تنظيف أسنان كلبك أو إذا كان كلبك يعاني من الكثير من تراكم الجير. مثالي للاستخدام كمزيل لجير الكلاب، هذا الرذاذ هو طريقة بسيطة وفعالة للحفاظ على أسنان كلبك في أفضل حالات! تم تركيب منظف أسنان الكلاب هذا من مكونات طبيعية، مما يمنح جروك نفس منعش بدون مواد كيميائية قاسية! يأتي بخاخ أسنان الكلاب هذا بنكهة النعناع المنعشة للعناية بأسنان الكلاب التي ستجعل رائحة كلبك لطيفة ومنعشة! البخاخ ذو حجم مريح ورائع للسفر، مما يجعله الإضافة المثالية لمجموعة أسنان كلبك أو مجموعة تنظيف أسنان كلبك. التعليمات: بخاخ الأسنان الطبيعي للكلاب سهل الاستخدام. ما عليك سوى رفع الشفاه على كلا جانبي فم كلبك ورشي 1-2 مضخة مباشرة على الأسنان واللثة لكل جانب. المكونات: ماء، كلوريد سيتيلبيريدينيوم، سوربيتول، بوليسوربات 20، نكهة، بيكربونات الصوديوم، بيروفوسفات التيراسوديوم، الليسوزيم، بروتيز، ثايمول، مستخلص أوراق الكاميليا سينسيس، كلوريد الصوديوم، جلوكونات الصوديوم، بنزوات الصوديوم. سوربات السيالسيوم. تحذير: تجنب ملامسة العين. يُحفظ بعيدًا عن متناول الأطفال. يُخزن في درجة حرارة الغرفة. غير مخصص للاستخدام البشري. توقفي عن الاستخدام على الفور واتصل مع الطبيب البيطري الخاص بك إذا حدث رد فعل سلبي، رضاك هو أولويتنا - إذا كان لديك أي أسئلة أو تعليق، فيرجى الاتصال بنا مباشرة على info@fetch4pets.com

description:
With our biodegradable bamboo toothbrush, you have not one but two reasons to smile bigger and brighter! Choosing an eco-friendly toothbrush means committing to protect our planet while safeguarding yourself and your family's oral hygiene.

 

About our bamboo brush handle:

Our bamboo toothbrush is made from 100% organic bamboo that is ergonomically designed for ease of use without straining your hands while brushing.

 

About our bristles:

Our soft bristles are made from charcoal-infused nylon. This makes them effective in removing plaque and tannins from teeth that cause staining and yet mild enough to protect the tooth's enamel.
While we understand that our bristles are not made from 100% organic and biodegradable material just yet, we have at least eliminated about 90% of the plastic used in making our bamboo toothbrush.

 

What does it replace?

Our bamboo toothbrush replaces the old nasty plastic toothbrush that we have all been accustomed to. A plastic toothbrush takes about 400 years to decompose, whilst bamboo will only take around 4-6 months if you are using a home composter and about 3 years if you will put it back to the soil to decompose on its own.

 

Why is it better?

Bamboo is a renewable resource and in fact, the fastest-growing plant - which can be harvested in a span of about 5 years. This means that we do not have to worry about exhausting this resource, unlike other plants that takes more than a decade to mature before they can be harvested. To top it all off, bamboo is 100% biodegradable and guaranteed safe for our environment. Once you have used the bamboo toothbrush and are ready to discard it, all you have to do is to add it to your home composter and should only take around 4-6 months to decompose.

SoFresh Toothbrush's Patented Design
SoFresh has a patented double-tiered bristle design.

What makes it more effective?
The SoFresh shorter, thicker bristles do the easy cleaning that your typical toothbrush accomplishes. The SoFresh longer, thinner bristles easily reach deeper between teeth and below the gum line. No other toothbrush does a better job at removing plaque from those areas most people neglect.

What colors can I order?
SoFresh Adult toothbrushes come in 6 colors: Blue, Gray, Purple, Orange, Seafoam, and Yellow

Are SoFresh soft toothbrushes?
Yes. All SoFresh toothbrushes are rated soft. Keep in mind there isn't another Soft toothbrush that has this patented design. The longer bristles keep this toothbrush from flattening during use. When your typical soft toothbrush flattens out during brushing it actually makes your toothpaste more abrasive. When bristles flatten they create a flat surface with abrasive toothpaste that studies have shown can damage your teeth and gums. This is especially important if you use 'whitening' toothpaste, which is usually very abrasive.

How often should I replace my toothbrush?
Dental professionals recommend a new toothbrush every 3 months. Your SoFresh will easily last 3-4 months.

What are the bristles made of?
SoFresh Flossing Toothbrush bristles are made of an exclusive material. These special micro-textured bristles were chosen because it is softer and more elastic and durable than your average nylon or plastic bristles.

title: Bamboo Toothbrush with Charcoal Infused Bristles - 100% Biodegradable by 32Roots
bullet_point: [Charcoal Infused Bristles, 100% Biodegradable Mao Bamboo Handle, Water Resistant, Heat Treated]
description:
OUR STORY
We wanted to create a product that would contribute to making a smaller environmental impact and encourage others to rethink their plastic use. The American Dental Association recommends we replace our toothbrushes every 3-4 months... That's a lot of plastic when we consider our total U.S. population of over 325 million! Even if half the population doesn't change their toothbrush out every 3-4 months as recommended, that's still a lot of plastic going into our landfills, and that's where we come in...

OUR MATERIALS
Our toothbrush handle is made of 100% biodegradable Mao bamboo, which is an environmentally sustainable timber. This bamboo was grown in the subtropical monsoon climates of the Zhejiang Province in eastern China. The bamboo is heat treated to carbonize it's surface, giving it a quality finish and good service life. Our bristle material is Nylon, DuPont. "Wait a minute, this isn't completely plastic-free!" We know, and down below are our reasons why.

Some companies utilize animal hair, most commonly boar/hog hair, to replace plastic use entirely on their products. While we one day want to be entirely plastic-free, animal hair can often be not as durable or effective for teeth as Nylon/DuPont bristles for several reasons:

Individual hair thickness and length is not uniform.
The porous nature of the bristles makes contamination more probable.
Their absorbency makes rapid wear and deterioration more likely.

OUR FUTURE
While our current route isn't 100% plastic-free as we would like, we hope to create a completely biodegradable product in the near future. With ever changing technology and innovative replacements for plastics, it is possible for a better product and better world. We hope our consumers will bear with us until then!
